name: Increff
summary: Warehouse management plus algorithm-driven merchandising and inventory optimisation for omnichannel retail. There is no public pricing and no flat fee — every deal is quoted case by case against warehouses, users and modules, so budget for an enterprise implementation.
best_for: retail brands and omnichannel sellers at real scale needing warehouse management plus algorithm-driven merchandising and inventory optimization
skip_if: you're a small or single-channel store where simpler inventory software suffices, or you can't commit to an enterprise implementation
honest_knock: This is enterprise omnichannel supply-chain software, and the opaque, quote-based pricing signals the target customer: retail brands with real scale, not small stores. The value — algorithmic merchandising and inventory optimization — only pays off at a catalog and volume large enough for those optimizations to move money. For a small or mid seller, it's likely more platform (and cost and implementation) than the problem warrants. For a scaling omnichannel brand, it's built for exactly that.

pricing.notes: No public pricing, re-verified 2026-10-02 and consistent across every reading we have. Increff's own /pricing URL still returns a 404, and our monthly captures of the site from July to September 2026 produced no amount at all. Increff prices every deal case by case, scaled to the operation — warehouses, users and which modules you take (WMS, merchandising) — which their partnership team confirmed to us directly on 28 Jul 2026. There are no published tiers to compare, so budget for an enterprise implementation and ask for a tailored quote.
